dct_description_sm: The objectives of this study were: 1) determine species distribution, migration routes and timing of major fish species utilizing the lower delta, 2) locate significant overwintering areas, 3) review baseline knowledge of fish populations of the Mackenzie Delta and coastal Beaufort Sea by compiling and incorporating existing literature (especially in describing habitat critical to the maintenance of the resource), 4) examine the food habits of the fish to determine their dependence on food organisms which may be adversely affected by contaminants associated with offshore exploration, 5) establish the seasonal and geographic sensitivity of the resource, 6) examine lagoons subject to inundation from the Beaufort Sea and ascertain their role in the life history of major species.
dct_title_s: Fishes of the outer Mackenzie River Delta
